📄 Security chief highlights Mazandaran’s role in Iran-Iraq War

📌 Sari, IRNA – Secretary of Iran’s Supreme National Security Council Mohsen Rezaei has highlighted the role of Mazandaran Province’s fighters in the Iran-Iraq War, describing them as courageous and outstanding defenders of Iran.

In a message marking the opening of the Third National Congress of Mazandaran Martyrs on Thursday, Rezaei highlighted the province’s historical role in defending Iran’s independence and the ideals of the Islamic Revolution.
​
The official praised the fighters’ achievements in major operations in Faw, Shalamcheh, Mehran and the Karkheh region, as well as their continued role in subsequent defense missions, including the defense of holy shrines and the battle of Khan Tuman.
​
Rezaei also added that the congress, commemorating 14,500 martyrs from the province, would help preserve the legacy of those who lost their lives in defense of the country.

Ari Fleischer, former White House press secretary for president George W. Bush, in response to Vice President Vance’s X post: 

Mr. Vice-President,

The problem was not the Iran War. It was the cease fire.

If you start a war, you need to win it and finish it – otherwise don’t start it.

This war should have been over six months ago, with the Strait of Hormuz wide open and oil flowing. The second and third tiers of Iranian leadership should have been destroyed, and we should have supported the pro-western forces who could have taken leadership. We stood on the brink of a new, more peaceful Middle East - and then we blinked. We had a chance not only to deny Iran nuclear weapons, but to get rid of the world’s biggest supporter of terrorism.

Instead, we had a cease fire, which was followed by months of will we or won’t we finish the job. Every day was a different message. There still is. Is the war over? Is it about to begin? No one knows. There is confusion and inconsistency.

In June 2025, America was not involved. This was an Israel vs Iran issue.

No one forced the United States to attack Iran then, or in February of 2026. It was a decision made by President Trump. In my opinion, it was the right decision.

Once the decision was made, we should not have stopped until the regime fell. But instead, you negotiated a cease fire that didn’t last, didn’t work and left us in no man’s land, with higher prices and our troops still deployed.

Our troops could have been home, the Navy returned to its bases, a peaceful regime in place , new alliances forged, and gas prices below $3.00 a gallon.

No, Mr. Vice President. It’s not the war. It’s the so-called cease fire.

Lindsey Graham’s sister lost yesterday in SC, one of the most MAGA of states. One of the reasons is the Iran war and the push for regime change.

Trump must establish a presidential commission. It has to be done. It must be done. It’s our only way out of here.

And if there’s no cooperation, then we have to question: Is this America’s greatest ally?
